description: Your most important number deserves more than a plain text box. Canvas KPI Card by DataFactZ is a premium, all-in-one metric tile that combines a bold primary value, variance arrow, status badge, sparkline trend, and icon — all inside a single, elegantly styled card. One visual. Every insight decision-makers need. The KPI Card That Thinks Like an Analyst Most KPI cards show a number and stop there. Canvas KPI Card goes further: it calculates what that number means relative to your target, surfaces the trend behind it, and signals status with color — automatically. Drop it into any dashboard and it transforms raw data into an answer before anyone has to ask a question. Key Features - Responsive Typography — The primary value scales intelligently to fill the card at any size, from a compact mobile tile to a full-width hero card on a 4K display. No manual font sizing needed. - Five Variance Calculation Modes — Go beyond simple percentage change. Choose from Percentage Variance, Absolute Gap, Remaining to Target, Achievement Ratio, or Status vs. Target (Good / Warning / Bad). - Seven Arrow Styles — Simple (↑↓), Chevron (▲▼), Caret (▴▾), Trending (↗↘), Steep (⬈⬊), Flat (→), or None. Positive and negative colors are independently configurable. - Smart Status Badge — Auto-detects Good, Warning, or Bad based on configurable thresholds (default: 80% = Warning, 100% = Good).
